markets.rules_primary: If Washington plays in at least 5 primetime games during the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this market, a primetime game is any Pro Football regular season game officially scheduled and played in one of the following nationally designated broadcast windows: Sunday Night Football, Monday Night Football, and Thursday Night Football. Additionally, the nationally televised Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day games will also count toward a team’s total, regardless of start time. Note: The season opener scheduled for Wednesday, September 9 will not be considered a primetime game, as it does not fall within any of the designated broadcast windows listed above. 

Only games that are actually played in one of the above designated national windows will count toward a team’s total. If a team is initially scheduled for a primetime game but is later flexed out and the game is moved to a non-primetime time slot, that game will not count toward the team’s total. Conversely, a game flexed into a primetime window will count.
